order: This round reopens the quartermaster review to close every finding still open. The analyze function must re-check a recorded confirmation against live evidence at every call, testing the timestamp match, the live predicate, fresh-throttle status, exhaustion, and any malformed latest line, rather than trusting a confirmation simply because it sits inside the freshness window. The confirm path refuses and appends nothing whenever a bucket is throttled, exhausted, or malformed, and it never grants blindly through any of those three. Every public entry point has to validate the forecast and the two staleness bounds as finite numbers, and it must throw instead of silently coercing a string. The disputed finding gets re-ruled against the reviewer's verbatim text while the first round's text stays struck through, and the dropped finding's own line comes back on its own. Then the status summary's quick-start claim and the incident attestation both get fixed, so the record finally matches the true outcome.
claims: The adversarial suite grew by 33 cases and now spans four sections. Each new case was checked failing against the pre-fix version before the fix landed, including the exploit that dispatched instead of gating and the range error thrown from the throttle predictor. Once the fix was in place the full suite ran green again, so the exploit path is closed and not merely hidden. The disputed finding was re-ruled against the reviewer's verbatim text, the incident record was reconciled against its sibling report, and every remaining nit got resolved.
